otherText: No prices on this page: every item is included in the buffet. Red text is only item numbers, piece counts ('2 pzs', '8pzs') and 'Picante +'.

Layout: two columns. Left: NIGIRIS (1-10), HOSOMAKI (201-205), TEMAKI (401-404). Right: GUNKAN (101-105), URAMAKIS (301-311). Section headings in a black Japanese-style display font, each followed by a red brush stroke and a product photo (salmon nigiri, tuna hosomaki, shrimp temaki, salmon tartar gunkan, salmon-wrapped uramaki).
No 'Fuera de buffet' banner, no page number and no other text on this page; the bottom has a decorative solid red wave over the pale red seigaiha background.
Items printed without any allergen icon: 10 Mango, 203 Aguacate, 204 Pepino, 205 Mango, 404 Temaki vegano, 105 Gunkan de fruta, 307 Tori catsu.
